clips.title: The story
paras: In Menethil Harbor, Sida asks travelers to recover her bag from the ooze that swallowed it. She visits Ironbeard's Tomb regularly, but fled when foul oozes filled the barrows.

Sida lives in Menethil Harbor and often travels northeast into the Wetlands to pay homage at Ironbeard's Tomb. On her latest visit, foul, dripping oozes had filled the ancient barrow. She panicked and hurled her satchel at one of them. The ooze swallowed the bag whole, giving Sida just enough time to flee back to the port town. Now she asks travelers to search for it.

Ironbeard's Tomb lies near Dun Modr, the contested stronghold, and holds the remains of a storied dwarven hero. Corruption in the surrounding marshland draws amorphous, acidic slimes that consume anything in their path. Sida cannot remember which creature swallowed her belongings. Travelers must search the tomb grounds and cut through the creeping blight to find her drenched satchel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.
I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.
The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!
I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank you, friend! I was afraid that it was lost for good!
She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.
Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
